detail.longDescription:
Attached: 2 images

My bodged together personal data center draws 1.3kW continuous, higher when computing. It has 15kWh battery storage backup (+ a lot more if I switch on the house microgrid during an outage).  The heat pump water heater nearby recycles the waste heat into hot water 😆 

EDIT: There are 3 servers missing from this photo as they're placed elsewhere: 1 off-site air-gapped backup mirror, 1 onsite air-gapped mirror, and 1 onsite public data archive.

100% solar powered. No cloud needed.  Oh and all of this is DDR3 platforms!! #selfhosted #selfhosting #homelab
